entries.name: Astro blog
entries.description: A static Astro blog with MDX posts in a zod-validated content collection (draft/published/unlisted status), React islands, Tailwind with typography, sitemap and RSS, optional generated OG images, and vitest plus astro check.

entries.name: Astro site + Effect API
entries.description: A Bun workspace with a static Astro site (React islands, Tailwind), a Node API on Effect's HttpApi and a shared contract package, so islands call the API through a typed client. The API can also serve the built site.

entries.name: React Router on Cloudflare Workers
entries.description: A full-stack React Router app on Cloudflare Workers with server rendering, JSON resource routes, typed bindings and a cron handler slot, plus Tailwind, Biome and integration tests that run in the local Workers runtime.

entries.name: Go HTTP API
entries.description: A Go HTTP API on the standard library (net/http, slog) with no web framework. JSON resources share one error envelope and request logging, the server shuts down cleanly on SIGINT and SIGTERM, and race-enabled tests run against the built binary.

entries.name: Go CLI
entries.description: A Go command-line tool with cobra commands, viper config (file, env, flags), structured errors with actionable suggestions, human and JSON output, testify tests with race detection and a coverage floor, and golangci-lint.

entries.name: Expo app + Hono API
entries.description: Bun-workspace monorepo with an Expo Router app (NativeWind, TanStack Query), a Bun + Hono API (zod-openapi, Drizzle on Postgres), and a shared zod schemas package; the app reaches the API through a typed Hono client behind a hooks layer.

entries.name: Next.js app on Node
entries.description: A full-stack Next.js App Router app served by Node, with server components, Server Actions validated by zod, ESLint, Vitest with Testing Library, and a Playwright browser test against the production build.

entries.name: FastAPI service (Python API)
entries.description: A Python JSON API on FastAPI and Uvicorn with no frontend, managed with uv and make. pytest runs the real app in process, structlog request logs carry ids, errors share one envelope, and verify fails when the committed OpenAPI spec drifts.

entries.name: Python API + React SPA
entries.description: FastAPI backend (uv, ruff, mypy strict, pytest) plus a React single-page app (Vite, React Router in SPA mode, TanStack Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) that talks to the API through a typed client generated from its OpenAPI spec.

entries.name: React Router with Effect
entries.description: A server-rendered (SSR) React Router app served by Node, with loaders and actions on shared Effect services, typed HTTP errors and structured logs, plus Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Vitest and a Playwright smoke test.

entries.name: SvelteKit app on Node
entries.description: A full-stack SvelteKit app built with the Node adapter and served by Node, with server load functions, zod-validated form actions, svelte-check, Vitest and a Playwright test against the production build.

entries.name: Tauri desktop app with React
entries.description: A Tauri desktop app with Rust logic in a crate workspace behind a thin shell, and a React/Vite frontend that calls it through tauri-specta typed IPC or a mock transport in the browser and tests. Biome, Vitest, Playwright, clippy and a check on crate dependency direction cover both halves.

entries.name: TypeScript HTTP API with Effect
entries.description: A Node HTTP API on Effect's HttpApi, with schema-first REST resources, tagged errors mapped through one status table, structured request logs, a platform-free core that also runs as a web fetch handler, Vitest through real HTTP, and a one-route proving slice.

entries.name: TypeScript CLI with Effect
entries.description: A Bun-compiled TypeScript CLI with Effect commands and services, strict stdout/JSON contracts, lazy config, structured logs, Vitest, and compiled-binary tests.

entries.name: TypeScript MCP server with Effect
entries.description: A stdio MCP server on Effect's MCP modules, serving typed tools and a resource over newline-delimited JSON-RPC, with Vitest unit tests and a real client handshake against the built server.

entries.name: AGENTS.md and agent guardrails
entries.description: AGENTS.md as the one project guide for every coding agent, with hooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that block destructive commands and secret writes. Claude Code and OpenCode also lint on write and format the agent's edits; Claude Code gets CLAUDE.md and Cursor a rule pointing at AGENTS.md.

entries.name: Bun binary releases
entries.description: Release a Bun-compiled CLI as standalone binaries for macOS and glibc Linux on x64 and arm64, with SHA256SUMS, a checksum-verifying install.sh, an atomic self-update command and a tag-triggered GitHub release workflow.

entries.name: Claude Essentials plugin
entries.description: Enables the claude-essentials (ce) Claude Code plugin for the project and adds path-scoped rules that point Claude at its skills for testing, error handling, debugging, and writing.

entries.name: GitHub Actions CI
entries.description: A GitHub Actions workflow that runs the project's own make targets or package scripts on every push and pull request, with SHA-pinned actions in the default preset, least-privilege permissions, and path-filtered jobs for monorepos.

entries.name: Claude Code TypeScript hooks
entries.description: Bun TypeScript hook helpers and tested Claude Code guards on top of agent-ops (destructive commands, package manager, generated files, typecheck on write), plus /check, /test and /feature commands, architect and reviewer agents, and a docs/harness.md guide.

entries.name: Clerk auth for Expo and Hono
entries.description: Clerk sign-in for the Expo app and session verification on the Hono API, with auth on by default behind a public-path allowlist, a dev bypass, and tests that run Clerk's real verification against a local keypair with no account or network.

entries.name: Cloudflare D1 with Drizzle
entries.description: Typed D1 bindings, Drizzle's D1 driver, checked-in SQL migrations, and isolated local database tests without a Cloudflare account.

entries.name: Cloudflare Pages
entries.description: Deploy a static site's build output to Cloudflare Pages with wrangler (installed as a dev dependency, run through bunx), covering production deploys from the default branch, preview deploys for pull requests, and headers and redirects config.

entries.name: Docker images + GHCR
entries.description: Production container images (multi-stage, non-root, healthchecked) for each deployable part of the project, plus a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and publishes them to GitHub Container Registry after CI passes.

entries.name: PostgreSQL with Drizzle for Next.js and SvelteKit
entries.description: PostgreSQL for the Next.js and SvelteKit stacks through Drizzle ORM and node-postgres (pg): Docker Compose dev and test databases, checked-in SQL migrations with a drift check, a server-only database module and repository, a readiness route, and tests on databases cloned from a migrated template.

entries.name: Effect testing and API skill
entries.description: Effect testing with @effect/vitest (fresh real layers per test, TestClock instead of sleeps, typed failure and defect assertions), shipped Effect guidance for each agent, and an agent skill written from the installed Effect release's declarations.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry (OTLP) for Effect servers
entries.description: OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics over OTLP for the Effect server in typescript-api, astro-fullstack and react-router. One observability layer adds trace ids to the existing logs, exports nothing without an endpoint, and is tested with an in-memory tracer and a loopback OTLP receiver.

entries.name: Effect Schema
entries.description: Effect Schema as the one validation and typing layer for data crossing a trust boundary (requests, config, storage, third-party and LLM output), with branded ids, tagged errors, JSON Schema for tools, and round-trip plus property tests.

entries.name: PostgreSQL with Effect SQL
entries.description: PostgreSQL for the Effect stacks (typescript-api, react-router, astro-fullstack): Docker Compose dev and test databases, migrations run by an explicit command, a scoped connection pool, a schema-decoding repository behind an Effect service, and tests on a private database per test file.

entries.name: Git hooks (lefthook)
entries.description: lefthook git hooks that format and lint staged files, enforce Conventional Commits, and run the project's tests before push.

entries.name: GoReleaser
entries.description: Tag-driven releases for a Go binary with GoReleaser, covering cross-platform builds with version ldflags, archives, checksums, a conventional-commit changelog, a GitHub release workflow, and optional Homebrew publishing.

entries.name: OpenRouter LLM provider
entries.description: OpenRouter as the LLM provider for a TypeScript project: an optional API key, model discovery with a ten-minute cache, routing settings, bounded retries with safe upstream errors, a scriptable local stub server for tests, and an eval report format with a dry-run checker.

entries.name: OpenRouter web chat
entries.description: A web chat app on OpenRouter: streaming replies, a model picker, tool calls, contact extraction, server-side history, usage and cost, Markdown export and a stub-backed Playwright flow.

entries.name: OpenRouter CLI chat
entries.description: A terminal chat app for typescript-cli on OpenRouter: an OpenTUI chat screen and scriptable commands with NDJSON events, tools also served by a stdio MCP server, chats saved as JSON with Markdown export, and stubbed replay and eval checks.

entries.name: PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy for Python
entries.description: PostgreSQL for the FastAPI stacks (python-react, python-api): Docker Compose dev and test services with healthchecks, SQLAlchemy async models with Alembic migrations, make db-* targets, and a test harness that gives each test file its own database cloned from a migrated template.

entries.name: PostHog analytics
entries.description: PostHog analytics in the web client, disabled when no key is set so tests, CI, and sandboxes need no account, with a typed event catalog and a pre-init buffer.

entries.name: REST resource conventions
entries.description: Agent rules for naming and shaping HTTP resources (plural nouns, methods and status codes, one resource shape, cursor pagination, versioning), independent of framework and layout, plus an AGENTS.md section recording the project's choices.

entries.name: rr remote test runner
entries.description: Configures rr (github.com/rileyhilliard/rr) so the project's test, lint, and build commands can run on remote machines over SSH, with a committed .rr.yaml of named tasks, an AGENTS.md section, and the rr Claude Code plugin.
